difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a separated morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, the existence part of the valuative criterion in the sense of algebraic spaces is equivalent to the same condition tested only on the solid diagrams with a valuation ring A and fraction field K, as in the scheme formulation (source lines 8615-8634). Only (1) implies (2) needs proof, and it is immediate from the push-down lemma: the criterion produces a diagram with an arbitrary extension K' of K and a valuation ring A' dominating A, and the existence statement for separated morphisms pushes that solution down to a morphism Spec(A) -> X completing the given diagram.
